== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[He's No Jedi (Errata)]] (<code>1261_35</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-35-Hes_No_Jedi.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-hesnojedi-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[He's No Jedi]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table with 5 cards from outside your deck face down under here. Twice per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). If This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time on table, for remainder of game lightsabers may not add to Force Drains or 'swing' more than once per battle. Cloud City Occupation is canceled.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number, copyright line) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-35-Hes_No_Jedi-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B09 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
